memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Visit for routine hypertension and insomnia follow‑up.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient reports good control of blood pressure at home, occasional difficulty falling asleep, no chest pain or palpitations.
EXAMINATION: BP 138/86 mmHg, pulse 78/min, weight 78 kg, height 1.70 m, BMI 27.0 (obese). Advised on reduced salt intake and daily 30‑minute walk.
IMPRESSION: Hypertension, stage 1; insomnia, mild. Labs and ECG pending.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue amlodipine 5 mg OD, telmisartan 40 mg OD, melatonin 3 mg HS, trazodone 50 mg HS. Order fasting lipid profile, fasting blood sugar, serum creatinine/eGFR, potassium, ECG. Return if chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, blood in stools, or worsening insomnia with daytime sleepiness.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Visit for hypertension review and insomnia check.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient notes mild ankle swelling after long shifts, reports BP readings averaging 142/88 mmHg, sleep onset latency improved to ~30 min.
EXAMINATION: BP 144/90 mmHg, pulse 80/min, weight 79 kg, BMI 27.3 (obese). Mild pitting edema bilateral ankles. Advised low‑salt diet, leg elevation, continue exercise.
IMPRESSION: Hypertension, uncontrolled; insomnia, improving. Consider adding low‑dose thiazide.
ARRANGEMENTS: Add hydrochlorothiazide 12.5 mg OD, keep amlodipine 5 mg OD, telmisartan 40 mg OD, melatonin 3 mg HS, trazodone 50 mg HS. Repeat serum creatinine/eGFR and potassium in 4 weeks. Return if increased edema, dyspnea, chest pain, fever >39°C, or worsening insomnia.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Autumn review for hypertension, insomnia and influenza vaccination.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient reports stable BP ~138/86 mmHg, no ankle swelling, sleep onset latency ~20 min, feels rested.
EXAMINATION: BP 136/84 mmHg, pulse 76/min, weight 78.5 kg, BMI 26.9 (overweight). Advised maintain current diet and activity.
IMPRESSION: Hypertension, controlled; insomnia, well‑managed. Annual lipid and fasting glucose due.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue current meds. Order fasting lipid profile, fasting blood sugar, serum creatinine/eGFR, potassium. Administer inactivated influenza vaccine today (0.5 mL IM). Return if chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, blood in stools, or new/worsening insomnia.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Winter hypertension and insomnia review.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient reports occasional nocturnal awakenings, BP home readings averaging 140/88 mmHg, no edema.
EXAMINATION: BP 142/90 mmHg, pulse 78/min, weight 79 kg, BMI 27.3 (obese). Advised review of sodium intake.
IMPRESSION: Hypertension, borderline; insomnia, mild nocturnal waking.
ARRANGEMENTS: Increase telmisartan to 80 mg OD, keep amlodipine 5 mg OD, hydrochlorothiazide 12.5 mg OD, melatonin 3 mg HS, trazodone 50 mg HS. Repeat fasting lipid profile, fasting blood sugar, serum creatinine/eGFR, potassium in 3 months. Return if chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, blood in stools, or worsening insomnia.
